stories.title: India raises fertilizer subsidy by 64%
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a ₹62,370 crore fertilizer subsidy for the 2026-27 Rabi season, exceeding the previous year's budget by ₹24,417 crore. With total annual outgo projected to top ₹3 lakh crore due to rising global input costs, the government remains committed to subsidised pricing for farmers.

stories.title: Net direct tax collections rise 11.8%
stories.summary: Net direct tax collections reached ₹14.42 trillion as of November 10, marking an 11.8 percent increase compared to the same period last year. While gross receipts grew by 14 percent, a 25.9 percent jump in refunds moderated the net total to 53.5 percent of the annual budget target.

stories.title: Air India loss reduction aids Singapore Airlines
stories.summary: Singapore Airlines reported a 44 percent decline in first-half net profit to SGD 134 million. The group offset some of this loss through a ₹2,000 crore reduction in Air India's operating losses. Singapore Airlines holds a 25.1 percent stake in the Indian carrier.

stories.title: Stand-Up India scheme extended until 2031
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet extended the Stand-Up India scheme for five years, through March 2031. The extension includes a ₹4,111 crore credit guarantee corpus intended to support financial assistance for 250,000 additional entrepreneurs from women and Scheduled Caste communities. The scheme continues its focus on targeted lending.

stories.title: Renewable energy saves India $100 billion in imports
stories.summary: India avoided over $100 billion in coal and natural gas import costs between 2011 and 2025 through renewable energy expansion, according to the IEA. Projected savings are expected to reach $240 billion by 2030 as the country reduces its exposure to international fossil fuel market volatility.

stories.title: Mudra loan guarantee scheme extended
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet extended the Credit Guarantee Fund for Micro Units until March 2031 with a ₹5,000 crore corpus. The scheme supports loans under the Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana, with officials confirming the annual guarantee fee has been reduced to 0.75 percent to lower borrowing costs.

stories.title: Government approves ₹62,370 crore fertilizer subsidy
stories.summary: The Union Cabinet approved Nutrient Based Subsidy rates for the Rabi 2026-27 season, requiring a tentative budget of ₹62,370 crore. This outlay is ₹24,417 crore higher than the previous year's requirement. The rates apply from October 1, 2026, to March 31, 2027, to ensure affordable fertilizer availability.

stories.title: Government mandates EVs for staff cars
stories.summary: The Ministry of Finance has designated electric vehicles as the default choice for government staff cars. The purchase price ceiling for these vehicles has been doubled to ₹20 lakh, while the limit for petrol, diesel, and hybrid models remains at ₹10 lakh. Conventional cars are now secondary.

stories.title: Medical device PLI scheme extended to 2036
stories.summary: The government has extended the Production Linked Incentive scheme for medical devices until 2035-36, with a remaining outlay of approximately ₹2,700 crore. The scheme, which launched in 2020-21, has supported the domestic manufacturing of over 60 high-end medical devices and components to date.

stories.title: GST council proposes ITC dispute safeguard
stories.summary: The GST council is considering a safeguard allowing taxpayers to seek personal hearings against input tax credit restrictions under Rule 86A. The Federation of Indian Micro and Small & Medium Enterprises stated the move could help businesses resolve credit disputes and reduce working capital disruptions caused by blocked credits.

stories.title: Centre eyes easing e-commerce export rules
stories.summary: The government is reportedly planning to ease regulatory requirements for e-commerce platforms to help MSMEs scale up exports. Sources indicate the centre is pushing both domestic and global platforms to assist small businesses in reaching foreign buyers, aiming to simplify the process of selling handcrafted goods abroad.

stories.title: Sensex hits nine-month high
stories.summary: The Sensex rose 772 points to close at 81,879.40 on Wednesday, marking its highest level since February. The Nifty 50 also gained 0.84 percent to close above 25,250. The rally was attributed to foreign fund inflows, positive quarterly results, and a sustained moderation in global crude oil prices.

stories.title: Benchmarks extend gains on FPI inflows
stories.summary: Benchmark indices rose for the second consecutive session on Wednesday, with the Sensex gaining 0.95 percent to close at 81,879.40. The Nifty 50 ended at 25,255.05, supported by auto and banking stocks. Foreign portfolio investor inflows and lower crude prices continue to steer market sentiment.

stories.title: Rupee reaches seven-month high
stories.summary: The Rupee closed at 93.69 against the US Dollar on Wednesday, near a seven-month high. Analysts at HDFC Securities attributed the appreciation to strong foreign institutional inflows and lower crude oil prices. A rebound in the dollar following recent inflation data limited further gains for the local currency.

stories.title: Nifty 50 recovers 13.5% from lows
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 has recovered 13.5 percent from its war-induced lows, narrowing year-to-date losses to 3.35 percent. Following a surge in Wednesday's trade, HSBC, Citi, and Bernstein have raised their targets for the index. The market continues to build on its recent rally amid improving investor confidence.

stories.title: Nifty closes higher despite inflation data
stories.summary: The Nifty 50 closed at 25,255.05 on Wednesday, up 0.84 percent, after hitting an intraday high of 25,424. Gains were tempered by US inflation data, which revived concerns regarding Federal Reserve rate hikes. The index has gained 11.1 percent over the last ten sessions.

stories.title: Rupee recovers from record low
stories.summary: The rupee ended at 93.69 per dollar on Wednesday, reaching its highest point since April. The currency has recovered since hitting a record low of 96.96 in May. It is now down about 4% year-to-date, nearly halving its losses from its worst point in the year so far.

stories.title: Indian markets rise on banking gains
stories.summary: Benchmark indices touched their highest levels in nearly nine months on November 11, with the 50-share index rising to 25,424. The rally was led by banking and auto stocks, supported by foreign fund inflows and easing crude oil prices. The market ended the session up 1%.

stories.title: Foreign investors return to Indian equities
stories.summary: Indian benchmark indices reached their highest levels in nine months on November 11. Foreign investors turned net buyers of Indian equities in November, infusing 53,739 crore rupees in the first nine days. This follows two consecutive months of outflows from the market.

stories.title: Titagarh Rail Systems reports profit jump
stories.summary: Titagarh Rail Systems shares gained 5.04% on November 11 after reporting a 49.23% year-on-year jump in consolidated net profit to 63.17 crore rupees for the July-September quarter. The SENSEX rallied 1.7% during the session, supported by foreign fund inflows and positive quarterly earnings momentum.

stories.title: Nifty Bank index nears record high
stories.summary: The Nifty Bank index surged 2.5% to 61,241.90 on Wednesday, driven by buying in private and public sector banks. The index is now less than 1% away from its all-time high of 61,764.85, which was last touched on February 3, 2026.

stories.title: Warburg Pincus leads race for Pricol unit
stories.summary: Warburg Pincus is in talks to acquire a 10-20% stake in a Pricol business unit that makes digital dashboards for two-wheelers. The unit is valued at 5,000 crore rupees and accounts for half of Pricol's annual revenue. Other global private equity funds also expressed interest in the deal.

stories.title: Haldiram begins IPO process
stories.summary: Haldiram is considering a public listing in late 2027 with an estimated issue size of 10,000 crore rupees. The company is targeting a valuation of more than 1 lakh crore rupees. An executive noted that the complex business structure means the process could take over a year.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO sees strong demand
stories.summary: Anthropic is seeking to raise as much as 90.4 billion dollars in an IPO and private placement. The company claims the offering would be the biggest listing of all time, exceeding SpaceX. The IPO is reportedly multiple times oversubscribed, though details remain subject to change.

stories.title: EasyJet shareholders back Apollo takeover
stories.summary: EasyJet shareholders voted 97.07% in favour of a 5.7 billion pound takeover by Apollo. The deal aims to take the airline private by the end of the first quarter of next year. It still faces regulatory scrutiny in the EU regarding airline ownership rules.

stories.summary: The sale is intended to unlock funds for Fairfax's purchase of a 60% stake in IDBI Bank from India's federal government and the Asian country's largest insurer. The IDBI deal, valued at 528.78 billion rupees ($5.56 billion), is among India's largest cross-border banking transactions. To

stories.title: Blackstone to invest in IIFL Finance
stories.summary: Blackstone is set to acquire a 16% stake in IIFL Finance for 5,000 crore rupees. The investment is part of a larger 6,414 crore rupee capital raising plan approved by the board. The funds will be used to strengthen finances and expand the company's gold loan business.

stories.title: India records 12 billion dollars in October deals
stories.summary: India's business landscape recorded 227 transactions valued at 12 billion dollars in October. This represents an 8% increase in deal value compared to the previous month, despite a 2% dip in the total number of deals. The activity was fueled by the Fairfax-IDBI Bank acquisition.

stories.title: Blackstone to buy 16% in IIFL Finance for Rs 5,000 crore: What's the deal all about
stories.summary: Global investment firm Blackstone is set to buy nearly 16% stake in IIFL Finance for Rs 5,000 crore. The investment is part of a larger Rs 6,414 crore fundraise approved by the company's board on Tuesday. The deal will make Blackstone a key investor in

stories.title: Coca-Cola India files for IPO
stories.summary: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings filed draft papers for a 15% offer for sale on November 6. The company will receive no money from the listing, which is targeted for 2027. Price bands and offer dates have not been disclosed for the proposed share sale.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip India receives IPO approval
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip India has received approval from SEBI to proceed with an initial public offering. The company confidentially filed its draft papers in July 2026. The proposed offering is expected to be an offer for sale by its parent company and ibibo Group.

stories.title: Amazon to pay $3 million over Prime cancellation hurdles
stories.summary: Amazon has agreed to pay $3 million in refunds to Arizona customers who encountered obstacles while trying to cancel their Prime memberships. The settlement follows a 2024 lawsuit from the state Attorney General, who accused the company of making it deliberately difficult to end subscriptions. The settlement arrived.

stories.title: Unacademy appoints new CEO as Munjal shifts to chairman
stories.summary: Unacademy co-founder Gaurav Munjal is moving from chief executive to executive chairman, with chief business officer Akhilendra Kumar taking over as CEO. The change follows the company's acquisition by upGrad. Munjal stated he remains fully involved in daily operations and the upcoming upGrad IPO.

stories.title: Telecom minister calls fraud a global threat
stories.summary: Speaking at the ITU conference in Doha, the Minister of State for Telecom identified fraud through calls and messages as a global threat. The minister noted that India’s fraud alert system has prevented suspected losses of Rs 5,000 crore. Trust is now a stated priority for connectivity.

stories.title: Fixed deposit auto-renewal at lower rates
stories.summary: Fixed deposits are marketed to risk-averse investors seeking predictable returns. When depositors fail to claim maturity proceeds, banks may auto-renew the funds at current, potentially lower interest rates. The accumulated corpus remains, but the future yield is subject to the bank's discretion at the time of renewal.

stories.title: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank marks 105 years with AI tools
stories.summary: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank has launched a multilingual AI telecalling service and a Smart Kiosk as part of its 105th anniversary celebrations. The bank aims to strengthen its customer offerings and expand its national presence, according to managing director Salee S Nair. The bank is now agile.

stories.title: Swiggy records 10.7 percent rise in Diwali orders
stories.summary: Swiggy reported a 10.7 percent increase in food delivery orders during the Diwali weekend compared to last year. The platform delivered an average of 97,545 orders per hour, with Masala Dosa and Kaju Katli emerging as the most popular items. Appam and Samosa also made the list.

stories.title: Mother Dairy to increase milk prices
stories.summary: Mother Dairy is raising liquid milk prices by Rs 2 to 4 per litre in the Delhi-NCR market, citing higher fodder costs and uneven monsoon conditions. The company stated that green and dry fodder prices have risen by 20 percent. Other markets face similar phased increases.

stories.title: Namo Bharat ridership reaches 5 crore
stories.summary: The Namo Bharat corridor has reached 5 crore passenger journeys, with the final crore added in 93 days. The NCRTC reported that ridership has accelerated since the project began in October 2023. The corridor recorded a single-day peak of 168,666 passengers, according to the corporation.

stories.title: Company registrations rise despite global headwinds
stories.summary: India recorded 154,093 new company registrations and 68,938 LLP registrations in the first seven months of the fiscal year. This represents a 12 percent increase in company incorporations compared to the previous year. The base of active companies is widening as closures remain low.

stories.title: Tea industry groups support minimum price proposal
stories.summary: Five tea industry associations have backed a government committee recommendation to introduce a minimum sustainable price for tea. The proposed benchmark links prices to a composite index of wage movements and inflation. The associations have urged the Ministry of Commerce to notify the price immediately.

stories.title: Deepinder Goyal launches health-tech wearable
stories.summary: Deepinder Goyal has introduced a 2-gram wearable device priced at 85,000 rupees. Promotional materials claim the device can measure thermal, immune, and cognitive readings to transform health regulation. It sticks to the temple area and monitors blood supply and heat dissipation in real time.

stories.title: EPFO advises pensioners on digital certificate renewal
stories.summary: The EPFO has reminded EPS-95 pensioners to renew their Digital Life Certificates using the Umang app and face authentication technology. The organization stated that the process can be completed from home to avoid potential disruptions in pension payments. The certificate remains valid for one year.
